title: Imagery registration: hyrcania
frame: place frame: metres from the place anchor in atlas/app/atlas-data.json, x east, z south, MapLibre Mercator scaled at the anchor (tools/build_osm_context.py Frame)
turnConvention: turnDegClockwise: the plan's page axes are turned clockwise on the map by this angle (east towards south); pxPerM: plan pixels per metre; planPoint (pixels) lands on placePoint (place frame)

imagery.service: Esri World Imagery (World_Imagery MapServer), zoom-18 tiles; metadata from its identify query at the place anchor
imagery.use: measurement only; tiles and resampled images are not archived (Esri terms of use)

method: The plan is matched to Vantor WorldView-2 imagery (Esri World Imagery, 21 October 2023, 0.5 m, stated accuracy 5 m) by searching the turn, scale and shift that put its dark pixels on the imagery's edges (tools/imagery_registration.py fit), then checked by overlay and an independent part or source.

figures.citation: Patrich 1989 Fig. 22, p. 256: cisterns and pools of Hyrcania; 0–50 m bar in five segments; no north arrow

checks.elevation: with the fit, the figure's contours follow the 10 m elevation model's contours round the hill (the model was not used in the fit)
checks.features: the bridge's double line lies on the dark north-west to south-east line in the imagery; the double pool, the round cistern and the southern cisterns fall on dark pits
checks.bar: the bar's five 10 m segments span 1027.5–1257.5 px: 4.61 px/m; the fit's 4.633 is 0.5 % above
checks.earlierAttempt: a full-circle search on the walls alone (30 September and again here) gave no clear turn; the figure's page-up is about north, as its bridge and the imagery's line first showed

positionsNote: Read on the registered figure, about ±2 m; the bridge is drawn 112 m (Patrich 2002) from its south-east end at the summit track.

placement.note: the model is built in the place frame from these positions; each part stands on the modern terrain at its own place

uncertainty_m: about 3 between figure and imagery; the imagery's own stated accuracy is 5
